title: Libby preclinical-pipeline candidate row
description: Row per candidate drug / compound / treatment strategy that is EARLY in development or not yet developed, surfaced by the preclinical_PhD_screener from the scientific literature. Distinct from preclinical_evidence.jsonl (which is mechanism evidence for interventions already in or near the clinic): this file is the forward-looking horizon scan of ideas not already surfaced by trial_screener / clinician / researcher.

candidate_id.description: Stable snake-case / kebab id for this candidate idea. The preclinical_reporter reuses it as the link key between preclinical_recommendations.jsonl and this file.

inclusion_status.description: Did this candidate enter the synthesis handed to the preclinical_reporter (`included`), or was it reviewed and set aside (`considered_excluded`)?

exclusion_reason.description: Required when `inclusion_status: considered_excluded`. Brief reason — e.g. 'already surfaced as a clinical-stage drug by trial_screener', 'mechanism does not target a stated feature', 'evidence is a single non-reproduced in-vitro report'.

intervention_label.description: Human-readable name of the drug, compound, tool molecule, or strategy (e.g. 'WRN helicase inhibitor HRO761', 'USP1 inhibitor KSQ-4279', 'POLQ-inhibitor + PARP-inhibitor combination', 'BRCA1 mRNA re-expression strategy').

intervention_type.description: Modality / shape of the candidate. `conceptual_strategy` is for not-yet-drugged target ideas where no specific compound exists yet.

targets.description: Snake-case identifiers for the patient targetable feature(s) this candidate acts on. Mirror profile.json::targetable_features[].feature (snake-cased). First entry is the primary target.

target_feature_label.description: Human-readable label of the targetable feature this candidate addresses (e.g. 'genomic instability / HRD', 'CCNE1 amplification').

development_stage.description: How far along the candidate is. Bounded BELOW clinical maturity by design: anything already enrolling patients belongs to trial_screener, not here. `conceptual` = an idea with no compound yet; `early_translational` = patient-derived models / co-clinical data but no trial.

mechanism.description: How the candidate engages the targetable feature. <= 3 sentences.

rationale.description: Why this is a promising idea FOR THIS PATIENT'S stated feature(s). <= 4 sentences. The load-bearing argument the preclinical_reporter ranks on.

novelty.description: Required for included rows. One sentence stating why this candidate is NOT already covered by trial_screener / clinician / researcher — the boundary guard that keeps this file forward-looking (e.g. 'no registered trial in any indication', 'academic tool compound, no IND', 'repurposing hypothesis with no oncology development program').

evidence_strength.description: Required for included rows. Qualitative strength of the preclinical / conceptual support. Calibrated for early-stage work: `speculative` = mechanistic hypothesis only; `strong` = reproduced in-vivo proof-of-concept in a relevant model.

key_manuscripts.description: The 'potential manuscripts' passed to the preclinical_reporter. One object per supporting paper / preprint. Empty array allowed only for `conceptual_strategy` candidates with no published support yet.

preprint_server.description: e.g. 'bioRxiv', 'medRxiv' when the source is a preprint rather than a peer-reviewed paper.

finding.description: <= 2 sentences: what this paper showed that supports the candidate.

model_systems.description: Model systems behind the supporting evidence (e.g. 'HGSOC PDX', 'BRCA-WT ovarian organoid', 'CRISPR synthetic-lethality screen').

translatability_score.description: Judgment of how readily this idea could move toward this patient (model fidelity, target homology, dose plausibility).

case_match.description: How well the supporting models match the patient's tumor / biomarker profile.

developability.description: How far the candidate is from something a patient could access, and what it would take to get there (e.g. 'tool compound only, no clinical-grade molecule', 'approved for another indication — repurposing trial would be needed').

risks.description: Counter-productive-MoA, toxicity unknowns, target-validation gaps, or resistance liabilities that temper enthusiasm.

caveats.description: <= 2 sentences. Translation cautions or superseded-by relationships. Don't duplicate exclusion_reason.
